scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix functions ci
scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-handmade-pet-goods --ui "npm run seed && npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run lint -- --deny-warnings && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-handmade-pet-goods --only firestore,storage,auth,functions "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix web run build:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-handmade-pet-goods --only firestore,auth,storage,hosting "npm run seed && playwright test"
